propositions: A commit-msg hook must reject commits with subject lines exceeding 50 characters or body lines exceeding 72 characters, while preserving Gerrit's Change-Id stamping by chaining the existing Gerrit hook as commit-msg.legacy.

The 50/72 rule checker must exempt trailers, TAG= lines, fenced code blocks, indented literal blocks (4+ spaces or tab), table rows, and lines where the over-length comes from unsplittable atomic tokens (URLs, paths, dotted identifiers).
The Makefile target 'make hooks' must verify both pre-commit and commit-msg hook installation and warn if Change-Id stamping is not found, exiting non-zero only when a hook file is missing.
.pre-commit-config.yaml must include default_install_hook_types: [pre-commit, commit-msg] to enable both hook types via bare 'pre-commit install'.
CONTRIBUTING.md must document the 50/72 enforcement rule, the exemption carve-outs, why the hook runs at commit-msg stage, and the warning against running 'pre-commit install -f'.
